company.name: Doctolib
company.shortDescription: Doctolib is an online and mobile booking platform that helps users find doctors and make appointments.
company.description:
Doctolib is an online healthcare booking platform and management software provider.

For doctors, Doctolib offers a full-range service to improve bookings management, reduce no-show, and bring new patients to their office. For patients, Doctolib is a free online service to find a nearby health practitioner and book doctors or dental appointments 24/7 within a few clicks.

Founded in 2013, Doctolib is based in Paris, France.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Secondary Market round raised $346,152,515, or 29.81% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,336,918 to $4,153,830,178, a 778.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
